project.purpose: R2.1 owner-local plan for the existing temporary Skills-to-MCP bridge; retain only consumer-needed local responsibilities and upstream standards, not a permanent Skill ontology or Registry.

nodes.label: ScopedSourceTrustBoundary
nodes.responsibility: Resolve configured user/project standard Skill roots and workspace trust into allowed filesystem scope; prohibit arbitrary caller-selected paths or implicit trusted-project escalation.
nodes.authority: Skills bridge local config; client/Runtime security retains real privileges
outputs: bounded configured sources and project trust flags
nodes.behavioralContract: Unknown workspace or untrusted project must not silently widen filesystem discovery/read authority.
acceptance: Native source-scope and bad-workspace test cases preserve bounded authority
No remote caller grants itself new project trust
formalObligations: Real deployed config/token and client identity assumptions UNKNOWN
nodes.replacement: Upstream direct Client Skills resolution may supersede this responsibility after equivalent scoped trust acceptance
nodes.nextAction: Trace exact installed Gateway config and authenticated client consumers.

nodes.label: HostileSkillPackageScreening
nodes.responsibility: Screen candidate local Skill package files for unsafe exposure patterns before advertising/reading them through the compatibility bridge.
nodes.authority: Skills local source filtering; broader Security remains separate
outputs: qualified scan result and advisory hazards
nodes.behavioralContract: Bounded quarantine checks, not a complete malicious-content or prompt-injection proof; absence of a scanner finding never means Skill safe.
acceptance: Catalog invokes scan_skill_package under exact root scope
Negative scanner tests do not warrant general trust certification
formalObligations: Coverage against unobserved malicious payloads UNKNOWN
nodes.replacement: Favor mature external scanner where it preserves the specific bridge quarantine contract
nodes.nextAction: Confirm required scanner checks via real remote consumer read contracts.

nodes.label: SourceQualifiedSkillLookupAndRead
nodes.responsibility: Produce scoped Skill discovery/search, explicit resolution and exact file-content read under snapshot/instruction/package revision fences for clients without native standard loading.
nodes.authority: Skills owner bridge read projection; upstream Agent Skills asset semantics
inputs: authorized project/user sources and explicit Skill query/ref; snapshot and digest expectations
outputs: bounded visible Skill metadata, resolution and qualified read bytes
nodes.behavioralContract: Invalid/changed package identity, outside-root path or stale snapshot fails closed; lexical discovery and available results do not imply Skill invocation or trust.
acceptance: Exact source snapshot/package/instruction drift checks are kept native and negative-tested
Direct client support should allow removing redundant compatibility behavior
formalObligations: Client usage/actual runtime trust bridge remains UNKNOWN
nodes.replacement: Delete compatibility functionality after verified real consumer migration to standard native Agent Skills loading
nodes.nextAction: Bound current Gateway Skills caller behavior and direct-loading retirement requirements.

nodes.label: LegacyFourToolMcpProjection
nodes.responsibility: Project authorized Skill lookup/read into the existing four compatibility tools skills.list/search/resolve/read without claiming new portable Skills semantics.
nodes.authority: Skills MCP bridge; Gateway owns capability routing
inputs: authenticated MCP tool call and Skill resolver response
outputs: bounded MCP tools/call result and errors
nodes.behavioralContract: Remote calls never grant install/execute privilege; scoped identity and read fences remain mandatory, and no result establishes Skill content trust.
nodes.consumerQualification: CROSS_OWNER_GATEWAY_SOURCE_CALL; configured/live Gateway Skills routing UNKNOWN
acceptance: Four-tool wire shape preserved in native Skills tests
Gateway direct skills.resolve source path exists; physical opt-in and caller authority remain independently gated
formalObligations: Gateway physical routed result and correct principal binding UNKNOWN
nodes.replacement: Replace when direct client standard Skills/Plugin loading has demonstrated equal consumer behavior
nodes.nextAction: Trace Gateway runtime opt-in and migrate each actual compatible client.

nodes.label: StandardSkillsProtocolProjection
nodes.responsibility: Expose the standard Skills extension projection via existing protocol types, independent of Ordivon-specific four-tool compatibility naming.
nodes.authority: Agent Skills/standard protocol; Skills bridge only projects the wire
inputs: scoped standard Skill inventory and skills/list or skills/get protocol calls
nodes.behavioralContract: Protocol conformance and scope are distinct from semantic Skill correctness; tests cover only source-bound fixtures.
acceptance: Native standards wire fixtures and version context tests qualified without expanding four-tool compatibility
Do not represent this as a separate daemon or semantic registry
formalObligations: Live client standards consumption and source-to-installed corresponding evidence UNKNOWN
nodes.replacement: Prefer upstream maintained standards client/server implementation when actual consumer contract is satisfied
nodes.nextAction: Observe a real configured standards client under authenticated installed Skills deployment.

acceptance: Native bridges and consumer source refs resolve; installed/current client and external semantic proof remain UNKNOWN
